rows.commentary: 0.1: Kulwant Khejroliya overpitches first ball, allowing Andersson to smash it violently away to the deep mid-wicket boundary for four.
0.2: Kulwant Khejroliya bowls a wide to Andersson.
4.1: Jack Carson strikes immediately, drawing the edge as Rahul Tewatia holes out to Hollman for a duck.
4.2: Krunal Pandya launches Jack Carson downtown, clearing the ropes for six straight to long-off.
4.3: Jack Carson adjusts his length, but Krunal Pandya simply rotates the strike with a single down to long-off.
4.4: Shashank Singh works Jack Carson away into the vast expanses of deep extra cover for a brisk single.
4.5: Krunal Pandya targets long-off once more against Jack Carson, depositing the delivery with immense power for another maximum.
4.6: Krunal Pandya slices Jack Carson late past the keeper, guiding it fine to the third man boundary for four.
5.1: Kulwant Khejroliya departs without facing a delivery, marked retired out against Nathan Gilchrist.
5.2: Nathan Gilchrist drops short, allowing Rahul Tripathi to hustle back for a sharp couple of runs toward backward square leg.
5.3: Rahul Tripathi steers Nathan Gilchrist cleanly toward sweeper cover to pick up a comfortable single.
5.4: Krunal Pandya detonates against Nathan Gilchrist, launching a colossal six into the deep backward point region.
5.5: Krunal Pandya finishes the sequence by carving Nathan Gilchrist elegantly away to the deep backward point boundary for four.
5.6: Nathan Gilchrist fires it in, Krunal Pandya guides it firmly toward sweeper cover, and they scamper through for a single.
